```plato
// Basic boolean operations, which are also similar to set operations.  
interface IBoolean
{
    And(a: Self, b: Self): Self;
    Or(a: Self, b: Self): Self;    
    Not(a: Self): Self;
}

// Represents an interval of values. 
interface IInterval<T>    
    where T: IVectorLike
    inherits IValue
{
    Start(x: Self): T;
    End(x: Self): T;
}

// Represents a range of values. 
interface IBounds<TValue, TDelta>
    where TValue: IVectorLike, TValue: IDifference<TDelta>
    inherits IValue
{
    Min(x: Self): TValue;
    Max(x: Self): TValue;
}
```
